chain.title: One Block to Bind Them
chain.desc: Crafted from planks, a wooden chest, diamonds, ender pearls and a comparator, and links every inventory it touches into a single network.

chain.title: A Window Into Every Chest
chain.desc: Crafted from planks, a wooden chest, glass, glowstone and a comparator, then placed directly on the inventory connector.

chain.title: Hiding the Machinery
chain.desc: Crafted from planks, sticks and a wooden chest as a decorative cover for connector faces.

chain.title: Running the Line
chain.desc: Crafted from planks, sticks, a trapdoor and a wooden chest to carry the network away from the connector.

chain.title: Tapping a Distant Chest
chain.desc: Crafted from an inventory cable, planks, a wooden chest, quartz, diamonds and ender pearls to attach remote inventories to the network.

chain.title: The Bouncer
chain.desc: Crafted from sticks, wool and redstone dust, then loaded with item stacks to control what a connector accepts.

chain.title: Selective Intake
chain.desc: Crafted from an inventory cable connector, paper and quartz to add a built-in filter to the connection.

chain.title: Feeding the Network
chain.desc: Crafted from an inventory cable, planks and a hopper to push items from a chest into the system.

chain.title: Spitting It Back Out
chain.desc: Crafted from planks, sticks, a trapdoor and a wooden chest, and drops network items into the world in front of it.

chain.title: Standing In For Another
chain.desc: Crafted from planks, a trapdoor and a wooden chest to expose a distant inventory as if it were adjacent.

chain.title: The Watchman
chain.desc: Crafted from an inventory cable, planks, a comparator and a redstone torch to emit redstone when a chosen item passes a threshold.

chain.title: Crafting Straight From the Vault
chain.desc: Crafted from a storage terminal, a crafting table and diamonds, and pulls ingredients from the whole network.

chain.title: Filter by Family
chain.desc: Crafted shapelessly from an item filter, a comparator and a name tag to match entire item tags instead of single items.

chain.title: The Shapeshifting Sieve
chain.desc: Crafted shapelessly from an item filter, a comparator and a diamond to match items by recipe compatibility.

chain.title: Brush and Bucket
chain.desc: Crafted from sticks, wool, a bucket, a water bucket and black, blue, green and red dye.

chain.title: Blending Into the Wall
chain.desc: Obtained by using the paint kit on a placed trim to copy any block's texture onto it, and reverted with a water bucket.

chain.title: Cable in Disguise
chain.desc: Crafted from an inventory cable and sticks so it can be painted to match surrounding blocks.

chain.title: The Invisible Junction
chain.desc: Crafted from an inventory cable connector and sticks for a paintable version of the remote connector.

chain.title: Cutting the Cord
chain.desc: Crafted from planks, glass, glowstone, a comparator, ender pearls and a spyglass, then bound by shift-right-clicking a terminal or inventory connector.

chain.title: Across the Dimensions
chain.desc: Made in a smithing table from a wireless terminal, a netherite upgrade template and a netherite ingot for long-range and cross-dimension access.

notes: All 20 ids verified against assets/toms_storage/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. lang keys - the model stems and lang keys matched exactly, so nothing was dropped. Note the mandatory 'ts.' prefix on every registry name (toms_storage:ts.storage_terminal, not toms_storage:storage_terminal). Progression derived from the 21 recipe files in data/toms_storage/recipes/**, cross-checked against the mod's own docs: the minimum viable network is inventory_connector + storage_terminal placed on it, cables extend reach, filters gate intake, crafting_terminal upgrades the storage_terminal with a crafting table and diamonds, and the endgame is wireless_terminal -> adv_wireless_terminal via smithing_transform. Nothing in the mod uses energy. Only ts.painted_trim has no crafting recipe of its own - it is produced in-world by applying ts.paint_kit to a placed ts.trim, and trim_clean.json converts it back with a water bucket, which confirms it as a legitimate obtainable item. No unverifiable ids were written.
